about_the_game:
The ocean is mysterious and profound, with jellyfish and coral embellished with fantastic colors. The high-pressure environment under dreams makes people breathless. Does this pressure resonate with you in real life? After applying the answer sheet, anxiously waiting for the test paper to be issued, only to receive dazzling scores every time. Our dreams seem to be easily crushed like bubbles.

Just take a nap for a while and see the beautiful ocean world... but will the pressure disappear? Under the calm ocean, the wind and clouds roll, and the 'monster' lurks in the cave, waiting for an opportunity to move. Hurry up! Crossing numerous obstacles, but how can we return to the "original place of dreams" and explore a path to truly get rid of the "monster".

Wrapped in bubbles, immersed in the depths of the sea, struggling repeatedly will only lead to faster suffocation, and letting it fall will lead to hiding in the depths of the sea. Go find your own path, make your own choices, and reconcile with yourself.

This game is a 2D platform jumping game with a total of "seemingly" three levels, with difficulty gradually increasing. Players complete their redemption through this process, and the character is trapped in a bubble. Players have multiple ways to control the movement of the bubble:

1. Rolling on the ground

2. Jet in the air (jet time is limited)

3. Players can launch small squares, which will stay in the air and become a part of the scene. Players can step on these squares to assist in clearing the level

This game demo is from GlobalGameJam2025 and has won the Best Sound Effects and Best Teamwork awards at SFK Station in Haidian District, Beijing. The game was created by 10 high school students from Beijing. Please forgive me.

Production team : 郭思源 周嘉诺 徐钰航 郑楚铧 许靖雯 钱承祐 赵宇恒 王泽俊 顼博然 李雨桐
